purpose: post-change nonhuman holdout for exact canonical NER/RE; not independent human gold

selection.population: processed papers excluding all 36 papers in dev12, cross-check12, and holdout v3
selection.eligibility: abstract length >= 300 and neutral extraction cue regex present: dataset|benchmark|corpus|evaluate|experiment|method|model|framework|task|propose|introduce (with inflections)
selection.prediction_blind_detail: selected and labelled from processed abstracts only; existing per-paper extractor caches for these IDs were not read before the labels SHA-256 was frozen

limitations: Single nonhuman annotator; no inter-annotator agreement.
Selection is cue-enriched rather than a prevalence estimate for all 1,091 papers.
The slice is small and its labels reflect one explicit entity inclusion protocol.
Useful as a leakage-separated diagnostic only; it cannot satisfy an independent-human gate.
